description: First Languages Australia is a collection of resources listed in the DITRDCSA Data Catalogue under the Regional Data Hub group, published by First Languages Australia. Information and data sources on Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander languages. Includes interactive resources such as the Gambay: Australian First Languages Map. Also includes educational tools and resources for communities working on building language strength. Coverage is Australia; spatial detail follows the source and is not stated in the entry. The catalogue lists the update frequency as not stated, the status as current, and the entry was last changed on 2023-08-15. Files and pages listed: HTML (1 resources), reached from the source page and the catalogue entry, with the CKAN API giving the metadata. Access is free of charge and open; the licence is not stated in the catalogue entry (source page not read). Caveats: the record was written from the catalogue metadata only, so the source page was not opened, the file contents were not checked, and many entries are HTML landing pages or PDF reports, not data files. The subject is social or economic context with only a loose link to infrastructure. It gives regional context for capacity and investment planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-catalogue-australia.
